name: Planning Data green belt dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 190 green-belt geographies; collector last ran 20 July 2026. The page states annual returns are a snapshot and may not reflect boundary changes made after submission.
gate: Use exact current authority policy-map evidence before parcel scoring; national snapshot membership is not proof of current parcel policy.

name: Planning Data green belt core dataset
fact: Planning Data lists 16 green-belt core categories; collector last ran 21 July 2026.
gate: A core category groups green-belt areas and is not parcel geometry or development status.

name: GOV.UK Green Belt planning guidance
fact: Current Green Belt guidance covers grey-belt assessment, effects on the remaining Green Belt, sustainable locations, Golden Rules and openness.
gate: Guidance sets the decision framework; it does not label a target parcel grey belt or grant permission.

name: NPPF chapter 13 Protecting Green Belt land
fact: NPPF paragraphs 142-160 set Green Belt purposes, boundary-change rules, safeguarded-land treatment, grey-belt criteria and Golden Rules.
gate: Green-belt release, grey-belt status and Golden Rules each require proposal- and plan-specific evidence; none is automatic consent.

name: Planning Data local plan boundary dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 364 local-plan boundaries; collector last ran 20 July 2026 and origin is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Boundary membership helps identify the relevant plan but does not prove that plan is current, adopted or determinative for the parcel.

name: Planning Data local plan dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 1,047 current, emerging or historical local-plan records from 63 providers; newest data reached 22 July 2026.
gate: Each record still requires exact process, period, authority and document verification before policy use.

name: Planning Data local plan specification
fact: The specification defines local-plan, boundary, document and timetable datasets and supports CSV, GeoJSON, GML, GeoPackage, WFS and ArcGIS delivery.
gate: Schema compliance is data-structure evidence, not legal plan status or parcel allocation.

name: Planning Data local plans index
fact: The national local-plan page links local-plan, minerals-plan, waste-plan, boundaries, documents, events and timetables as a structured planning-data family.
gate: Dataset discoverability alone is not substantive policy evidence.

name: Planning Data minerals plan dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 75 minerals plans from seven providers; collector and newest data both reached 15 July 2026. Origin is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Plan index records require current authority document and period checks before applying minerals policy to a parcel.

name: Planning Data minerals plan boundary dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 44 minerals-plan boundaries; collector last ran 11 July 2026 and origin is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Boundary coverage identifies plan geography, not a mineral safeguarding area or development restriction by itself.

name: Planning Data mineral safeguarding area dataset
fact: The mineral-safeguarding-area dataset currently reports zero records, zero providers and no collection attempt.
gate: Zero platform records must not be interpreted as no mineral safeguarding area; use current mineral authority policy maps.

name: GOV.UK minerals planning guidance
fact: Government minerals guidance explains mineral safeguarding, consultation areas, extraction planning and the need for planning permission plus other relevant permits and approvals.
gate: Mineral resource or safeguarding presence does not create a presumption that extraction will occur, nor does it automatically prohibit non-mineral development.

name: NPPF chapter 17 sustainable use of minerals
fact: NPPF chapter 17 requires Mineral Safeguarding Areas and consultation areas where appropriate and states safeguarding should avoid needless sterilisation without presuming resources will be worked.
gate: Safeguarding is a planning consideration; exact mapped area and applicable policy are required before parcel conclusions.

name: Planning Data waste plan dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 71 waste plans; collector last ran 10 April 2026 and origin is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Waste-plan presence does not establish site allocation, capacity or planning permission for a target parcel.

name: Planning Data waste plan boundary dataset
fact: Planning Data reports 48 waste-plan boundaries; collector last ran 11 July 2026 and origin is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Boundary membership identifies the responsible waste-plan geography, not a waste-facility allocation or permission.

name: GOV.UK waste planning guidance
fact: Government waste guidance covers waste planning authorities, local-plan site identification, capacity evidence, strategic cross-boundary planning and environmental protection.
gate: Area-level waste need or capacity gap is not a parcel-level facility permission or viability conclusion.

name: Planning Data supplementary plan dataset
fact: Planning Data reports five supplementary plans from two providers; collector last ran 14 July 2026 and newest data was found 2 July 2026. Origin is MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Sparse coverage means absence is not evidence of no supplementary plan; exact authority records remain required.

name: Planning Data plan event dataset
fact: Planning Data exposes 47 plan-event categories including adoption, examination, Regulation 18/19 consultation and timetable publication.
gate: An event category is not evidence that the event occurred for a particular plan; exact timetable/event record is required.

name: Planning Data local plan event dataset
fact: The local-plan-event dataset currently reports zero records, zero providers and no collection attempt.
gate: Zero records must not be interpreted as no local-plan events; use plan timetable, authority and PINS evidence.

name: Planning Data protected view dataset
fact: The protected-view dataset currently reports zero records, zero providers and no collection attempt.
gate: No platform record is not evidence that a local protected-view policy does not exist; authoritative policy maps must be checked.

name: Croydon green belt geography
fact: Croydon is an authoritative Green Belt geography in the London core with entry date 1 December 2025 and downloadable full geometry.
gate: Apply only after exact canonical parcel intersection and current local-plan policy confirmation.

name: Dartford green belt geography
fact: Dartford is an authoritative Green Belt geography in the London core with entry date 1 December 2025 and downloadable full geometry.
gate: National snapshot geometry must be reconciled with any later adopted local-plan boundary change.

name: Sevenoaks green belt geography
fact: Sevenoaks is an authoritative Green Belt geography in the London core with 1 December 2025 entry date.
gate: Exact parcel intersection and current plan-map confirmation remain required.

name: East Hertfordshire green belt geography
fact: East Hertfordshire is an authoritative Green Belt geography in the London core with downloadable geometry and 1 December 2025 entry date.
gate: Do not infer grey-belt status or permission from Green Belt membership alone.

name: Birmingham green belt geography
fact: Birmingham is an authoritative Green Belt geography in the Birmingham core with downloadable geometry and 1 December 2025 entry date.
gate: Current exact policy-map relation and proposal-specific Green Belt tests are required.

name: Bury green belt geography
fact: Bury is an authoritative Green Belt geography in the Merseyside and Greater Manchester core with 1 December 2025 entry date.
gate: Core membership and boundary intersection are separate from development suitability.

name: Kirklees green belt geography
fact: Kirklees is an authoritative Green Belt geography in the South and West Yorkshire core with 1 December 2025 entry date.
gate: Exact parcel relation and current local-plan boundary evidence remain required.

name: Warrington green belt geography
fact: Warrington is an authoritative Green Belt geography in the Merseyside and Greater Manchester core with 1 December 2025 entry date.
gate: Do not convert Green Belt intersection into automatic refusal or a zero-growth score.

name: Cherwell green belt geography
fact: Cherwell is an authoritative Green Belt geography in the Oxford core with 1 December 2025 entry date.
gate: Green Belt and safeguarded-land status are distinct; exact local policy mapping is required.

name: Bolton green belt geography
fact: Bolton is an authoritative Green Belt geography in the Merseyside and Greater Manchester core with 1 December 2025 entry date.
gate: Use exact parcel intersection and current policy; national snapshot age remains a control.

name: High Peak green belt geography
fact: High Peak is an authoritative Green Belt geography in the Merseyside and Greater Manchester core with 1 December 2025 entry date.
gate: A Green Belt polygon is a policy constraint input, not a final planning outcome.
